candidates.change_summary: Replace `msg.sender` with a constant address in the `new EmergencyOracle(...)` creation so the new oracle owner differs.
Delete the `emit NewEmergencyOracle(...)` statement so the event is never emitted, changing the externally observable event log after the call.
Replace `msg.sender` with `tx.origin` in the `NewEmergencyOracle` event emission so the logged owner address differs for some callers.
Replace `msg.sender` with `address(this)` in the `new EmergencyOracle(...)` constructor call so the oracle owner becomes the factory contract, not the caller.
Delete the body of the `onlyJojoTeam` modifier so anyone can call `newEmergencyOracle`, changing who can create oracles.
Remove the EmergencyOracle deployment so the function completes without creating a new oracle or emitting the event with a real oracle address.
Change the emitted oracle address to address(0), so the observable event payload differs from the original deployment address.
Weaken the team check to allow any caller, so calls from non-JOJO-team addresses no longer revert.
Remove the onlyJojoTeam modifier from newEmergencyOracle, allowing any caller to deploy an emergency oracle.
Move the NewEmergencyOracle event emission before the EmergencyOracle deployment, so the event is emitted even if deployment behavior differs.
Replace the onlyJojoTeam caller check with an always-true condition, allowing any caller through.
